title: Global Regularity of the 3D Incompressible Hall-MHD Equations for Large Data
exact_target: For the intended three-dimensional incompressible Hall-MHD model, do all admissible smooth initial fields remain smooth for all time without a smallness assumption?

sources.citation: Li and Cui, Global Well-Posedness for the 3D Axisymmetric Hall-MHD System with Horizontal Dissipation, 2022, Introduction.
